summary.text: Kerry Benninghoff is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 171 since December 1, 1996 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He was the Centre County Coroner before joining the House.

paragraphs.text: Kerry Benninghoff attended Penn State University from 1980 to 1981.

His professional experience includes working as a carpenter, as an orderly and later a supervisor at Mount Nittany Medical Center, as a deputy coroner from 1985 to 1991, and as the Centre County Coroner from 1991 to 1996.
Benninghoff took office in the state House in December 1996.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Transportation Committee, and in 2021-2022 he chaired the Rules Committee.
